description: Implementation of command execution and testing utilities for a server component within the cuttlefish project, including classes CmdResult and CmdRunner for running commands and handling their output.

classes.name: CmdResult
classes.description: Represents the result of executing a command, including standard output, standard error, and return code.

classes.name: CmdRunner
classes.description: Encapsulates the logic to run a command with arguments and environment variables, capturing its output.

methods.name: CmdResult::CmdResult
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command result with stdout, stderr, and return code.

methods.name: CmdRunner::Run (Args, Envs)
methods.description: Runs a command given as arguments and environment variables, returning the result.

methods.name: CmdRunner::Run (string, Envs)
methods.description: Overload that tokenizes a string command and runs it.

methods.name: CmdRunner::CmdRunner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the command with parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: CmdRunner::Run
methods.description: Executes the command and captures stdout, stderr, and exit code.
